title: Outbound Stack Fingerprint
one_line: Detect whether a company runs cold outbound, which tools it sends with, and how many sending domains it operates.
description: Detect whether a company runs cold outbound, which tools it sends with, and how many sending domains it operates. Use when selling to sales teams, sizing a competitor's outbound, or qualifying whether a prospect already runs the motion you sell into.
paragraph: Whether a company already runs cold outbound is the single most useful qualifier for anyone selling outbound tooling or services, and it is visible from the outside: sending domains, mail records, and the fingerprints of the tools that provision them. This skill reads that infrastructure and reports scale as well as presence.

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: outbound-infrastructure-fingerprint 0.004 USD per domain.
Free. It starts the Mamba Labs MCP server with `npx`.

requirements_summary: Needs an Apify token (usage billed to your Apify account); Node.js 18+.
